subject: English
question_text: The pie chart below shows the time allocation of
stimulus: student's daily activities. Describe the chart in 150 words. You should highlight and summarize the information given below. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts The pie chart shows the time allocation of students daily activities. From this pie chart it is seen that students have to maintain the time allocation for their daily necessary activities. They spend 20% time for their study, and they also need recreation for which they spend 12% time. For playing they spend 5% time. They go to school everyday and stay school and home for which they spend 25% time. They also spend 30% time for sleep. For other types of everyday work, the students spend 8% time. In this way, in this chart we see the time allocation of the students daily activities. On the whole, the pie chart represents the time allocation of students everyday activities.
